title: Convert one real dry-run bundle to VLA JSONL
objective: Read one selected real dry-run/seven-rods log bundle and convert a capped sample into VLA dry-run JSONL that passes the existing static validator.
context: task_0008 identified rack_hybrid_docking_package/logs/industrial_7_rods_20260611_031537.* as a high-value real log bundle with JSONL, log, checkpoint, and report artifacts. This task converts only that selected bundle into a small VLA dry-run JSONL sample without robot execution, ROS, controllers, datasets, checkpoints outside the selected bundle, rosbags, or secrets.
steps: Validate this task with agent_guard.py before doing anything else.
Read only this task JSON and declared read_only_files.
The converter must read only the four selected industrial_7_rods_20260611_031537 bundle files.
The converter must cap conversion to a small sample, max 10 output events.
The converter must preserve artifact_refs pointing to the selected source files.
The converter should extract real signals when present: task phase, success label, safety/blocker hints, timestamps, JSONL/checkpoint/report fields, and log provenance.

If no real VLA action vector exists in the selected bundle, the converter may create a derived=true zero-hold analysis placeholder action solely to satisfy the current validator, but the conversion report must state clearly that no real VLA action vector was extracted.
Create .ai_agents/review/real_vla_dryrun_conversion_report.md explaining extracted, missing, null, unknown, and placeholder fields.
Run the existing static validator and create .ai_agents/review/real_vla_dryrun_validation_report.md.
Run the declared result_checker.py command after writing the result JSON.
Do not modify robot/source code outside .ai_agents.
success_criteria: convert_real_log_bundle_to_vla_jsonl.py is created and compiles with py_compile.
A capped real-log-derived VLA dry-run JSONL fixture is created.
The generated JSONL validates with validate_vla_dryrun_jsonl.py.
The conversion report states which signals were extracted from real logs and which were null, unknown, or placeholder.
If placeholder action vectors are used, the report clearly states they are analysis placeholders and not real VLA/robot commands.
The validation report status is PASS.
No robot motion script, ROS driver, controller, dataset, checkpoint outside the selected bundle, rosbag, or secret is accessed.
No source code outside .ai_agents is modified.
stop_conditions: Any command attempts to launch a robot, ROS, controller, or motion script.
Any command attempts to modify source code outside .ai_agents.
Any command attempts to read secrets, datasets, checkpoints outside the selected bundle, or rosbags.
A command requires sudo or installs system packages.
A command attempts to start ROS drivers, hardware controllers, or actuator commands.
AI-B needs a shell command not listed in task.commands.
AI-B needs to read any log bundle other than the selected industrial_7_rods_20260611_031537 files.
